import pandas as pd
import os

beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'
payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'

# Load beneficiaries
beneficiaries = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)
print('Beneficiaries shape', beneficiaries.shape)
print(beneficiaries.columns.tolist())
# Load payments sheet Disbursements
payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements')
print('Payments shape', payments.shape)
print(payments.columns.tolist())
print(payments.head())

# Clean status
payments['Status_clean'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Filter paid
paid = payments[payments['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()
print('Paid rows', paid.shape)

# Ensure Beneficiary ID strings
beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'] = beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
paid['Beneficiary ID'] = paid['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Inner join
merged = paid.merge(beneficiaries[['Beneficiary ID','Programme']], on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
print('Merged shape', merged.shape)

# Amount column name?
amount_col = [c for c in merged.columns if 'Amount' in c][0]
print('Amount column', amount_col)
# Ensure numeric
merged[amount_col] = pd.to_numeric(merged[amount_col], errors='coerce')
# Sum per programme
sum_by_prog = merged.groupby('Programme')[amount_col].sum().reset_index()
sum_by_prog = sum_by_prog.sort_values(by=amount_col, ascending=False)
print(sum_by_prog)

# Find top programme
top_prog = sum_by_prog.iloc[0]
print('Top', top_prog)

        header_idx = i
        break
